writing_system: Aza'raan independent plus dependent phonetic elements, inspired by Khmer and Malayalam but not an assertion of literal Khmer letters

positioning.linear_pronunciation: Dependent vowel after the host onset; dependent consonant follows its host by explicit lexical cluster rule
After its attached host; phonetic realization within the host syllable
Modifies phoneme of the specific letter it is attached to

non_standard_notes: A written cluster is not necessarily an IPA syllable or a single Unicode code point
The two-subscript limit includes glottal and click
Two independent letters never fuse into one host just because their font glyphs touch
Gemination is length metadata on the host and is not automatically a third subscript
No default or inherent A vowel is assumed because A quality requires an explicit accent
A free vowel is itself an independent host; a dependent vowel is a subscript letter
Consonant-plus-vowel host complexes are the normal modern syllabic written units
Native glyphs, ligatures, and Khmer Unicode assignments require the user's font/glyph data
rendering_algorithm: Parse spelling and detect historical lexeme overrides first
Resolve each sound to a base family and at most one accent per atomic letter
Select independent host and at most two ordered subscripts
Apply pre-host glottal before vowel realization
Apply post-host click after the associated phoneme
Apply vowel quality on the vowel's own letter, including if subscript
Apply length/gemination and then stress or emphasis, without creating extra subscripts
Reject overflow rather than silently deleting a sound

unicode_policy.khmer_coeng_reference: U+17D2 is the Khmer COENG joiner, but do not treat it as an automatic Aza'raan codepoint assignment
unicode_policy.grapheme_stability: Keep semantic character IDs separate from glyph display and Unicode mapping
